capabilities: move list items with their nested children via smart commands
move heading sections as one unit
move single lines or multi-line selections
configure hotkeys and toggle smart movement in settings
extras: No default hotkeys are assigned; the user must bind commands manually in Settings → Hotkeys. Listed under Community Plugins pending approval and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to move a whole logical block (list item with children, heading section, code block) without manually selecting lines and breaking list nesting.
summary: Editor plugin that moves lines and blocks up and down with Alt+arrow keys, handling nested lists, heading sections, and code blocks as units.
